verdict.rationale: Jira ships AI features (Rovo AI), so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, policy or commitment that excludes customer data from AI model training. The Rovo AI pages describe what the AI does, not how customer data is used for training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
